title: PHI-approved processing boundary required
description: Any component that touches PHI must run inside a PHI-approved processing boundary.

title: GDPR-compliant handling for personal data
description: Personal data must be processed only by components with a GDPR-compliant posture.

title: No PHI/PII in prompt or response logs
description: Telemetry and prompt/response logging must redact or exclude sensitive data.

title: Audit logging with subject traceability
description: Access to sensitive data or system-mutating actions must be logged with subject-level traceability.

title: Input/output guardrails required
description: Untrusted input meets a model in essentially every solution class; injection/PII-leak defence is not optional.

title: Evaluation harness required
description: If output quality cannot be measured, it cannot be operated safely — required for every AI system registration.

title: Observability and tracing required
description: Every production AI component must emit trace, cost, latency and tool-call telemetry.

title: Per-user authorisation on retrieval
description: Retrieval over sensitive or individually-scoped data must enforce the caller's own entitlements, not a shared service account.

title: Human approval gate before irreversible or material action
description: Actions that are irreversible or financially material require a human approval checkpoint before execution.

title: Approved model list only
description: Model inference must be served only through models on the approved list.
